slots.purpose: Open the guide with the core idea at a glance: different shapes read differently on a hand. Editorial, calm, luxury, sunlit.
slots.shot_brief: Two or three anonymous hands (different skin tones, light to deep, and different finger lengths) resting together on warm sunlit linen, each wearing a different-shape diamond solitaire (for example oval, emerald and round brilliant), photographed from above in soft golden outdoor daylight suggesting a destination ceremony without any real or recognisable place. Hero landscape 3:2 with negative space for a title crop. Anonymous cropped hand only (wrist to fingertips, no face, no tattoos, no identifying jewellery other than the ring), natural unpolished or nude-polish nails, relaxed natural pose. Plain platinum or white-gold solitaire band so the shape is the subject. Soft diffused daylight, true-to-life colour, neutral backdrop (linen, warm stone or soft grey paper), editorial and uncluttered, shallow depth of field. No jeweller, lab or brand logos, packaging or recognisable designs. Not a real person, not a celebrity ring replica. Landscape 3:2 (inline) unless noted.
